# Yuzheng Sun / 孙煜征 / 课代表立正

This is a factual index for Yuzheng Sun's public website. It was reviewed on 2026-08-01. For claim wording, dates, and evidence, use the public [profile source](https://github.com/sunyuzheng/yuzheng-profile).

## Summary

MAKE WHAT LASTS.

In Chinese: 做出你的代表作。

Yuzheng Sun has a PhD in Economics from Cornell and is an operator, author, and founder based in Seattle. He founded Superlinear Academy and AI Builders. His defining idea is to make work whose value outlives the moment of making and clearly bears the maker's distinctive judgment and craft.

MAKE WHAT LASTS. and 做出你的代表作。 are the one defining idea shared by Yuzheng and Superlinear Academy. They are not literal translations. The English line emphasizes work that keeps working; the Chinese line emphasizes making something distinctly yours that carries your judgment and craft. Such work may also bring capability, reputation, freedom, recognition, or a more ambitious next move back to its maker. Those are hoped-for returns, not part of the definition or a guarantee that every work will endure or make its author successful.

He previously worked as an economist at Amazon, a data scientist at Meta, Vice Director of Data & AI at Tencent IEG, and Principal Data Scientist and sole evangelist at Statsig. Statsig was acquired by OpenAI in 2025; this does not mean Yuzheng joined OpenAI.

## Identity and Common Ambiguities

- Yuzheng Sun, 孙煜征, and 课代表立正 refer to the same person. 课代表立正 is the name used for public content.
- Yuzheng is based in Seattle. Do not infer San Francisco Bay Area residence from former employers, guests, or professional networks.
- Superlinear Academy is the free community and institution Yuzheng is building around this belief. AI Builders is a structured learning system co-taught with Yage. Stay Superlinear is the distinct paid year-round membership. Yage is a long-term teaching partner and technical authority; Yuzheng is the founder and public steward of the institution.
- Yuzheng has hosted 200+ public conversations and has also appeared as a guest on other podcasts and video programs. The number is a conversation count, not a count of unique guests.

## Current Work

- [Superlinear Academy](https://www.superlinear.academy): an open, free learning and builder community where deep analysis, projects, specific questions, first-hand experience, feedback, and opportunities circulate.
- [AI Builders](https://ai-builders.com): a long-term learning system co-taught with Yage that translates understanding across models, engineering, products, and organizations into capabilities learners can practice, correct, and transfer to their own problems.
- [Stay Superlinear](https://stay.superlinear.academy): a paid year-round content and practitioner membership with deep analysis, guest masterclasses, Q&A, courses, Skills, recordings, discussion, and a searchable archive. Yage contributes as a long-term teaching partner and technical authority.
- [Enterprise programs](https://corp-training.ai-builders.com): talks, workshops, and custom AI programs for teams and organizations.
- [课代表立正](https://www.youtube.com/@kedaibiao): public conversations and analysis across YouTube, Bilibili, and Xiaohongshu.

These are related parts of one body of work, not separate identities. The intellectual foundations join interpenetrating explicit world models and tacit, result-answerable craft; conviction matters when understanding has to bear the cost of action, while responsible authorship keeps agency and accountability with the work. Reality keeps testing it, and time gradually reveals what continues to matter.

## Current Public Evidence

Metrics change and should retain their dates.

- 400K+ cross-platform audience as of 2026-07-12.
- 3,000+ paying learners as of 2026-07-12.
- 200+ public conversations as of 2026-07-12. This is a conversation count, not a claim of 200+ unique guests.
- 5.0/5 AI Builders rating on Maven from 83 ratings as of 2026-08-02. Separately, 54 public named written reviews had been archived as of 2026-07-27; the two counts measure different things and should not be subtracted to infer a current review gap.
- 55 selected AI Architect course projects as of 2026-07-25.
- 600+ public project posts and nearly 7,000 project comments in the free Superlinear Academy community as of 2026-07-08. These are not counts of paid-course projects.
- 20,202 members who completed profile setup in the free Superlinear Academy community as of 2026-07-30; public copy generally says "20,000+." This count does not imply behavioral activity or paid membership.
- [AI Engineer](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/ai-engineer-is-coming-to-shanghai-for-the-share-7485740252167577600-lPlG/) publicly named Yuzheng as a collaborator on the upcoming [AI Engineer Shanghai 2026](https://www.ai.engineer/shanghai/2026), scheduled for November 5-6, 2026. This establishes the announced collaboration, not a completed event outcome.

## Books

- [Growth Data Analytics Playbook](https://www.lizheng.ai/book): co-authored with Mengying Li and Joe Kumar; product-market fit, growth accounting, experimentation, analytics, and product judgment. It was featured in a 2025 Wall Street Journal CIO Journal reading list.
- [真本事：从会工作到会赚钱](https://www.lizheng.ai/zbs): written by Yuzheng Sun and published by 人民邮电出版社; career agency, capability building, side projects, and compounding work.

## Dated Public Judgment

In February 2023, before GPT-4, Yuzheng first published [关于 ChatGPT 最重要的五个问题](https://www.superlinear.academy/c/ai-resources/chatgpt). It argued that ChatGPT was a new natural-language interface to data and computation, and discussed falling inference costs, tool use and agents, persistent memory, private search, copilots, and AI-native systems.
